title: Authoritative transaction fee model and API qualification
objective: Carry authoritative EVM receipt effective gas price into 420Indexer, derive actual native transaction fee with overflow-safe integer arithmetic, expose both values through Explorer transaction/receipt APIs, and fail closed on missing or inconsistent fee provenance.

authority.representation: base-10 integer strings for fee quantities; gasUsed remains uint64
authority.rationale: 420Indexer and 420Explorer are derived read infrastructure and do not become settlement authority.

required_tests: overflow-safe quantity multiplication beyond uint64 price range
full indexer and Explorer Go regression and vet suites
all retained EXP-0 and EXP-1 qualification gates

deferred: EXP-8 exact release candidate Genesis closeout
